name: @adhd/sox-graph-store
description: Bi-temporal graph store — nodes + edges over SQLite with t_valid/t_invalid correctness, tExpires TTL, content-hash dedup, FTS5 sync, namespace isolation, and supersession chains. Schema migration via Drizzle ORM (ADR-0008). GraphBackendCapabilities flags prevent silent misuse of bitemporal / FTS / metadata-filter features.

concerns: schema migration via Drizzle ORM (ADR-0008) — drizzle-kit generated, applied at startup
bi-temporal nodes (t_valid / t_invalid) + tExpires TTL + isStale derived field
namespace isolation (NodeMeta.namespace — hard graph partition, default: "global")
FTS5 sync triggers (searchNodes scored by mechanism-agnostic score field)
edge upsert idempotency (writeEdge — safe for re-projection)
confidence as first-class epistemic field (distinct from importance ranking weight)
DEPENDS_ON edge rel for typed dependency graphs (plan DAGs, tool dep trees)

node.kind non-memory reuse contract (BL-295) — the node.kind CHECK constraint is a fixed enum (episode/entity/claim/community/session/generic) and is NEVER extended per consumer. A non-memory reuse case (e.g. a component registry) writes with kind:'generic' and carries its own sub-kind (e.g. 'component') in tags/metadata instead of registering a new kind. writeNode()'s kind param defaults to 'episode' and is validated against DEFAULT_NODE_KINDS, throwing ConstraintError for anything outside the enum.
invariants: records are NEVER deleted — invalidate() sets t_invalid (audit-preserving), supersede() mints a new node linked by SUPERSEDES
touch() updates mutable metadata (tExpires, confidence, name, tags) without minting a new node or SUPERSEDES edge — THROWS if nodeId is invalidated or missing
writeEdge() is upsert-idempotent on (src, dst, rel) — safe to call on re-projection
writeGraph() / writeNodeBatch() are atomic (single SQLite transaction) — all or nothing
searchNodes() returns [] (not an error) when capabilities.fullTextSearch === false
NodeFilter.validAt is honored only when capabilities.bitemporal === true, ignored silently otherwise
namespace is a hard isolation field (not a tag/filter convention) — absent → "global"

kind is one of DEFAULT_NODE_KINDS ('episode'|'entity'|'claim'|'community'|'session'|'generic'); an out-of-enum kind throws ConstraintError rather than a raw SQLite CHECK failure — there is no per-consumer kind registration
